source: Original source-native geometry and shader code authored for VECTOR//NOVA; one original generated storm radiance image supplied as an optional production sky texture

generatedImageAssets.ownership: Backdrop owns and releases the supplied texture exactly once

assets.method: Twelve wind-biased grouped Gerstner waves spanning 60–251 metres with horizontal displacement and exact sheltered normals. The full field remains active around both sides of the circuit; distance band limits preserve resolvable long swells at the horizon. Narrow protection follows actual banked deck clearance and local leviathan contacts. A shared profile drives the live Three.js shader and editable Blender study. Compression and crest activation select ragged whitecaps; directional chop and mipmapped procedural wind ripples separate small highlights from geometric swells. Ocean-only pre-race phase carries into simulation-time animation at green, preserving creature/event timing; manual pause and reduced motion freeze the waves.

reflection.type: bounded mean-plane scene reflection above water on High; sky-only on Low
reflection.source: Three.js Water camera math via Tech9 pond-water, adapted for local ownership, state restoration and quality gates

normalMap.source: Locally owned adaptation of _tech9/modules/island-ocean/src/oceanNormals.js; original procedural project code

assets.method: Deterministic instanced weathered pinnacles, grounded irregular boulder reefs, asymmetric antlers, thin sea fans and encrusting coral, plus route-cleared large fan/ribbon canopy gardens above the submerged road line, volcanic islands and marine titanium observatory; sampled road plus explicit flight-corridor clearance

Subtle derivative-filtered stochastic caustic patches and mineral mottling on submerged source geometry; no periodic grid, extra pass or projected texture. Irregular dark splash zones, restrained mineral residue, filtered basalt relief and damp pearl/titanium roughness share the existing mean sea level.
1600 deterministic world-space particles, reduced to 800 on low; stopped by reduced motion

Original sky panorama with seeded forward-anchored branched bolts and cloud glow, first event around3s then~12s cadence; one0.85s pulse, restrained3.2%screen flash and original stereo procedural2.8s crack/roll thunder. Simulation-time, mute/pause/reset/seek/reduced-motion safe. No new WebGL passes/lights/maps.
Sculpted 128 by 128 sediment mesh with broad Gaussian ridges; shared triangle-interpolated height helper anchors track foundations and reef roots to the actual rendered ground
Three unshadowed local cyan/violet/amber lights select nearby authored garden anchors, fade by distance and actual camera immersion, and add no render or shadow passes

Solve the actual banked road/sea-level intersection independently across the full road width, then draw a translucent animated horizontal waterline sheet and narrow foam edge. A deterministic swept craft-center crossing emits pooled spray, submerged bubbles and a fading surface ripple from the actual world-space crossing point. Uses simulation time; pause freezes; reset/navigation/teleport/time discontinuities suppress stale effects. Low halves particles; reduced motion freezes the sheet, hides spray and retains a fade-only ripple. Actual submerged landing contact emits a wider 2.35-second bubble collar from beside the hull above the receiving deck, with decaying forward momentum, reusing the existing pool; ordinary mode changes and recoveries do not trigger it.
Smooth camera-depth multiply absorption across scenery, near track/rails, ship and HUD; pointer-transparent CSS composite, clears outside underwater driving, shared by high/low.

Original 280m Blender sea worm with nacre shields, fins, photophores and vertex color variation. One loaded body supplies a curved first-jump breach and a submerged diagonal crossing with fixed world-space heading and speed-scaled timing. Existing foam and pooled spray accompany the breach. Pause/reset, reduced motion, loading failure and owned disposal are supported.
assets.sourceCountNote: Included in environment totals; source counts are distinct from rendered performance.

assets.method: Original panel-local rim relief and inset seals with licensed ambientCG Terrazzo019S mineral-composite PBR maps beneath a continuous physical clearcoat. Clearer pressure-insert centres retain denser grazing edges. Ceramic and exposed glazing borrow the district probe; membranes retain backdrop response. Positions, contact coordinates, gap lips and landing geometry are unchanged.
assets.ownership: Road owns panel attributes, materials and the three asynchronously loaded ceramic maps. The district reflection is borrowed and never disposed by the road.

assets.method: Locally authored bounded GPU rain, low landmark mist and intermittent support-contact spindrift, using Tech9 weather design ideas. Uses simulation time, high/low density, underwater suppression and reduced-motion gating. No new maps; three bounded draws.

limitations: Water combines the aligned storm panorama with a softened, throttled 512px planar reflection of nearby structures on High. The reflection is a mean-plane approximation and fades out over distance. It does not simulate fluid forces, curling breakers or screen-space refraction. Narrow crossing and contact protection preserves gameplay; underwater transmission is approximate.
Caustic lighting is a material approximation and does not simulate water-volume light transport.
Storm radiance represents distant atmosphere on a camera-centered sky sphere; the volcanic islands, reef and observatory are world-space geometry.
The generated sky is LDR radiance; the image does not supply HDR sun values or volumetric storm geometry.

Crossing foam/spray is deterministic visual presentation, not fluid simulation or a water collision system. The standing foam sheet uses a 14cm offset to avoid coplanar road/water flicker; the crossing curve and craft event are solved at the actual water level.
Source counts are not actual rendered performance certification; browser and foreground hardware evidence must be recorded separately.
